name: Elegant Post Manager
author: amine48

sections.description:
This plugin changes the posts interface to a new interface with the old interface features of adding, editing, deleting or editing posts.

Features

  • Custom search bar
  • Filter posts by categories
  • Filter posts by post status
  • Filter posts by publication date
  • Show post thumbnail
  • Show number of comments
  • Show number of visits to post
  • Show post status
  • Other features.
